solved-sheet.allDoneBody: Replay any level to collect the stars you missed.

1: Turn every light off. Tap the ringed light: it flips, and so do the lights next to it.
2: A tap flips a light and the lights next to it. Tap the ringed light.
Each tap flips a plus shape. Now tap the ringed light.
